trustNote: I design interfaces for insurance, fintech, logistics and e-commerce products — the kind of complexity most people never see, made simple to use. I blend strategy, research and craft to take a product from a messy problem to something people rely on every day.

faq.question: Who is Vitaly and what kind of projects do you take?
faq.answer: I'm a UX/UI and product designer with 7+ years of experience. I work on complex products — insurance, fintech, logistics, e-commerce and internal enterprise tools — and take them from a messy problem to an interface people trust on the first try.

faq.question: What does your process look like?
faq.answer: It starts with requirements and research, then low-fidelity prototypes for fast stakeholder feedback. Once the core flows are validated I move into visual design and a reusable component system, and keep iterating after launch using real user feedback.

faq.question: Do you work with existing design systems and teams?
faq.answer: Yes. I've worked inside enterprise teams with many stakeholders, and I build or extend component-based design systems so products stay consistent across web and mobile.

faq.question: Which platforms do you design for?
faq.answer: Web applications, responsive websites and mobile apps — including Android and cross-platform products — as well as dashboards and internal tools.

faq.question: How can we start working together?
faq.answer: Send me a short message about your product, goals and timeline. I read every message myself and reply with next steps.
